anatomy.flutter: Flutter has no counterpart: `background_effect.dart` is the page atmosphere, and nothing in the Flutter inventory carries a per-surface reveal glow.
anatomy.web: Two `@utility` blocks, `bloom-action` and `bloom-value`: a static `radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 60% at 50% 30%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-action|--color-value) 28%|22%, transparent), transparent 70%)` on a host.
anatomy.note: Web-only. These had been documented under `background-effect`, which is Flutter’s name for a different thing; they are recorded here under their own name so the collision cannot recur.

api.flutter: Flutter has no counterpart: `background_effect.dart` is the page atmosphere, and nothing in the Flutter inventory carries a per-surface reveal glow.
api.web: Two class names, no props. The tint is the action or value ramp mixed toward transparent; the geometry is percentages of the host.
api.note: Web-only capability, declared `origin: "web-only"` in the contract; there is no Flutter side to compare this dimension against.
